lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Ga2Se6 (reduced formula Ca2GaSe3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers in octahedral coordination by six Se neighbors, while Ca centers have nine geometric neighbors (six Ca and three Se) and Se centers have six neighbors (three Ca and three Ga). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ga octahedra and corner-sharing between Ga octahedra and Ca nine-vertex polyhedra.
